Changelog: 3.0.0.1: Settings rebuilt in the tablet look (Look, Dock, Behaviour, Apps, Account & data). Live sync no longer flashes 'Connecting…' when the server drops an idle connection. 3.0: a new tablet with a home screen, widgets, a dock and a sleep view. Every app rebuilt in the website's look and kept in step with aetherhold.naguya.tech both ways: Crafting (with a local solver), Market, Gathering, Collection, Routines, Events and a brand-new Raid Planner. Larger, sharper text for 4K screens. Command: /aetherhold (/xivhub still works).
Punchline: Aetherhold, in game. Because clicking sync is so 2023.
Description: Your FFXIV companion. Syncs your character to Aetherhold (aetherhold.naguya.tech) live and brings its tools into the game: market and shopping route, gathering timers, crafting and macro solver, collections, routines, events and raids. Cart, routines and crafter stats stay in step with the website.
Name: Aetherhold
Author: Naguya
